newsitem.title: UK: Britain sends condolences after Hong Kong fire.
newsitem.headline: Britain sends condolences after Hong Kong fire.

text.p: Britain's Queen Elizabeth and Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind on Thursday sent messages of condolence to the Governor of Hong Kong after a fire in the British colony killed 39 people and injured 80.

"Please convey my heartfelt sympathy to all those who lost members of their families or friends, or who suffered injury in yesterday's tragic fire," the queen said. "My thoughts are with them at this difficult time."
Rifkind said: "I was appalled to learn the news of the tragedy in Kowloon. On behalf of the British government I send you our deepest sympathies."
The fire hit a 16-storey shop and office block in the bustling Kowloon tourist district.
